primary_support_definition.geometry: standard NEON 10x10 only; SRER excluded from primary
primary_support_definition.repeat_support_definition: tagged individual with coordinate-bearing captures on at least 2 distinct trapping nights within the same exact-3-night plot-event

rationale.session_total: 30 gives a minimum hierarchical development pool rather than a handful of isolated bouts
rationale.taxonomic: four taxon concepts and two genera prevent a Peromyscus-only or single-lineage generality claim
rationale.geographic: six sites prevent one or two local populations from defining the result
rationale.repeated_genus_support: each of two genera must independently span repeated sessions and more than one site

decision_rules.if_all_pass: GO to pre-effect metric/model-development stage; W/B effects remain exploratory on RELEASE-2026 and cannot be relabelled confirmatory
decision_rules.if_any_fail: STOP the coordinate-decomposition route without lowering m, pooling one-night/4+-night bouts, adding SRER under the standard calibration, or widening the temporal session
decision_rules.permitted_post_stop: a separately preregistered model-based route may be considered only as a new estimand/design, not as rescue of this gate
